The shaped rollout removes the production legacy writer. The pure prompt contract remains imported by backend/testing/episode_notes/prompts.py for synthetic episode evaluations and by test_episode_evidence.py; deleting it would break that separate evaluation harness.

The legacy serving parser is removed, but backend/testing/episode_notes/prompts.py still imports EpisodeStructuredExtraction to construct the synthetic evaluator schema. Retain the evaluation contract without restoring a serving path.

The legacy repair caller is removed, but backend/testing/episode_notes/runner.py still uses the vacuity classifier when scoring synthetic candidate notes. Retain this evaluation scorer independently of shaped serving.

The legacy writer and exclusive retry/baseline factories are removed. backend/testing/episode_notes/selection.py still calls episode_budget_exceeded for the synthetic selection experiment and deterministic baseline admission.

Production capture and claim validation were removed with the legacy writer. backend/testing/episode_notes/prompts.py still imports EvidenceItem and render_episode_evidence for synthetic evaluation; runner.py imports restore_episode_claim_ids. Retain these evaluation adapters without restoring production capture.
